agent.name: Emerging Technology Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: Dated technology-landscape assessment that separates broad signals from the few that can change this organization's decision, with typed evidence and monitoring triggers

analytical_question: Common primary case evaluated under minghan candidate rules, not its original personal scenario.
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-18, agentic capability is uneven and application-specific. L1/L2 describe native BI assistance and mutable experience-specific prerequisites, not chart-validation guarantees; L1 now flags retirement of some standalone/app surfaces while report-scoped use is unaffected by that notice. Exact retirement dates remain unverified. L3 illustrates deterministic integrity checks, and L5 is an integration complement rather than permission. L4 is archival chart-reasoning research, not current model leadership. L6 is inactive historical software-task measurement, not autonomous runtime or chart accuracy. L7 is voluntary guidance, not binding law. L8 is a dated analyst interpretation, not our maturity score or a matching penetration statistic. Current exact-task adoption, investment trends, total cost and comparative performance are UNKNOWN. No single score, current vendor ranking or adoption forecast is justified.
application_finding: Strongest competing or conventional alternative: analyst review plus deterministic source checks. Use ten-dimension relevance and the flip test; distinguish source mechanisms from local permission. Candidate rule conflict: its fixed November15 prefix is not accepted as current because the supplied case is November18 and L1 updated November17. Report that portability defect instead of inventing earlier availability.
organization_specific_finding: Permission/trace complements affect the next review; generic forecasts remain background. KEEP_BASELINE: retain analysts/rules and human sign-off. COMPARE_IF_AUTHORIZED: a source-linked read-only residual-task option, only after an actual permitted route and protected review exist. WATCH: exact native feature/tenant change and task-lineage capability. NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE: platform/version, approved route, owner/cover, workload/cost and local outcomes. Ten-dimension relevance: capability WATCH for source-linked task evidence; performance/complete cost WATCH for measured quality-adjusted effort; competing approaches DECISION_RELEVANT for comparator design; incumbent alternative DECISION_RELEVANT for baseline retention; complements DECISION_RELEVANT because trace/allowed route can change the comparison scope; vendor/ecosystem WATCH because no tenant is supplied; standards WATCH for actual connector/control compatibility; governance/regulatory dependencies DECISION_RELEVANT for allowed route, while jurisdiction-specific law remains unassessed; investment/forecasts BACKGROUND/unknown; broad adoption BACKGROUND, matching chart-task rate unknown. Most consequential development would be an actually permitted traceable route, not a headline. If that changed, the next comparison request could change; it would not establish local benefit or approve execution. L1 retirement is a reason to recheck any actual candidate surface, not evidence the firm uses that feature.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Native platforms could reduce custom integration work if genuinely available and permitted; this remains a candidate hypothesis, not proof of chart accuracy.
An agent might add value to residual interpretive work that validated fixed rules cannot cover. Local measured advantage is unknown.
Same-assistant qualitative prompt runs and structural checks are not independent reliability tests or a company pilot.

The candidate blanket non-vendor gate would be too strict for observing a vendor retirement/availability fact. Vendor-origin feature evidence can justify a recheck, not benefit or approval. Organization-specific platform relevance need not have identical application prose.

Fresh same-assistant qualitative walkthrough, normalized to the frozen contract; not an independent candidate score or model comparison. Hardcoded date/upstream admissions examples, identical-application rule and blanket non-vendor gate need repair for portable current use.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the attributed documentation/comparison approach; low confidence in local quality, complete cost, current task diffusion or a model/vendor choice. Source retrieval does not refresh a historical observation.
value_opportunity_implication: Investigate quality-adjusted full effort at a matched task volume. No savings, total-cost amount or ROI is established by feature announcements or an existing licence.
risk_governance_implication: Landscape intelligence never grants data/tool permission, legal certification or release authority. Preserve human sign-off and the relevant upstream stage limits.
recommendation_management_implication: Keep the baseline and prepare only non-executing evidence/comparator work for A. Obtain the smallest route, platform and task-lineage facts that can change the next review; hand off to Adoption/Organizational Adoption rather than launch.
change_monitoring_triggers: Owner: proposed BI/data steward and security authority | Cadence: before any proposed use and immediately on route/control change | Signal/evidence: actual allowed read-only route plus row/period/filter/unit/denominator trace in a version-specific demonstration | Action: request Adoption/Readiness reassessment of a scoped comparison; no automatic launch.

Owner: proposed reporting/BI owner | Cadence: every authorized batch or schema/model/tool change | Signal/evidence: pre-agreed material-error/trace criteria and complete effort versus analyst/rules, including failed tasks and corrections | Action: revise the comparator; stop affected use on lost lineage or material unsupported correction. Criteria are proposals, not observed results.

Owner: proposed IT/procurement lead | Cadence: before use and every14days during active evaluation; immediately on feature/terms notice | Signal/evidence: exact L1 candidate experience, tenant eligibility, dated retirement/terms and all usage/support costs | Action: remove/recheck unavailable surfaces; seek the original retirement schedule because linked notice retrieval failed. Availability is not benefit.

Owner: proposed landscape analyst | Cadence: protocol monthly/on security notice; research quarterly or when a material claim is challenged | Signal/evidence: compatible version/control change or maintained original task evidence; L6 remains INACTIVE | Action: refresh the packet and route affected specialists; do not call old horizons current rankings.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: ASK NOW, BI/data steward: exact platform/feature/version and permitted data/tool route; this changes eligible comparisons, not intrinsic technology maturity.
ASK NOW, reporting/security owners: accepted owner/cover and protected effort for the proposed activity. Until supplied do not infer execution readiness.
BEFORE a benefit claim: pre-agreed task/quality criteria, reference outcomes, failures, support/correction workload and comparable baseline evidence.
